title: Lattice Fixed Vector Model
body_html:
Lattice Fixed Vector Model

For a lattice \(L\) in the symplectic space \(W\), the space \(S_L\) denotes the vectors in the oscillator representation fixed by the corresponding lattice subgroup of the Heisenberg group. In a generalized lattice model \(S(A^\ast)\) with \(A^\ast\subseteq L\), this is the image of the subspace of functions supported on \(L\).

The definition is independent of the auxiliary good lattice \(A\) and of the intertwining map between realizations.
